question: total road network length km
sql: SELECT round(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 1) AS total_road_km FROM lisbon_roads;

question: footprint area Torre VTS de Algés m2
sql: SELECT names."primary" AS building_name, round(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry), 1) AS footprint_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE names."primary" = 'Torre VTS de Algés';

question: avg building footprint by building type
sql: SELECT subtype, count(*) AS buildings, round(avg(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)), 1) AS avg_footprint_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings GROUP BY subtype ORDER BY avg_footprint_m2 DESC;

question: total road length by category km
sql: SELECT class, round(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY length_km DESC;

question: biggest building footprint
sql: SELECT names."primary" AS building_name, round(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry), 1) AS footprint_m2, height FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: length Passeio Marítimo de Algés km
sql: SELECT names."primary" AS road_name, round(SUM(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32629', always_xy := true))) / 1000.0, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names."primary" = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés' GROUP BY names."primary";
